binutils.description: GNU binutils (as, ld, objcopy, objdump, nm), built from the pinned GNU release tarball for each target. Free software (GPL); built privately, never committed.
binutils.signature: binutils-2.47.tar.xz.sig verified 2026-10-21: Good signature from Nick Clifton (Chief Binutils Maintainer), RSA key 3A24BC1E8FB409FA9F14371813FCEF89DD9E3C4F

targets.m68k-elf: 68000 game code: assemble, link with config/rom.ld, objcopy to the ROM image
targets.z80-elf: Z80 sound-driver code (later; the baseline treats it as data)

emu2.description: emu2, a small DOS emulator (GPL-2.0), runs the MS-DOS-hosted Microtec tools non-interactively. Built from a pinned commit.

mcc68k.description: Microtec Research MCC68K C cross compiler 3.3K (MS-DOS) with ASM68K 6.6A, from the archive.org floppy images. Proprietary abandonware acquired under ruling R006; private cache only, never committed or redistributed.
